\paragraph{RLVR training dynamics.}
\citet{rlsqueezes2026} show RLVR \emph{compresses} incorrect trajectories while SFT \emph{expands} correct ones, with training evolving linearly by amplifying early trends~\citep{wang2026linearity}; our results qualify this: the asymmetry manifests as a recovery capacity difference, but the expected accuracy gap vanishes when pruning preserves diversity ($|\Delta| \leq 1.8$\,pp; \S\ref{sec:decoupling}).
